nodes.text: An eight-month-old baby in Bengaluru is suspected to be India's first case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), a respiratory virus affecting vulnerable groups. The infection was detected in a private hospital, with confirmation pending lab results. HMPV cases have surged in China, https://t.co/zchVMOcpXH
